items.question: How many months before the current licence expires must an institution complete the requirements for renewing its institutional licence in the UAE?
items.gold: At least three months before the current licence expires.
items.fact: Renewal requirements must be completed three months before licence expiry.

items.question: Which UAE ministry is responsible for issuing institutional licensure for new higher education institutions?
items.gold: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.
items.fact: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research issues new institutional licences.
